roadster_desc: A low white wedge of a two-seat sports car with a surtling-core motor and cold-air thrusters: it hops over things, flies for a few seconds, rolls and flips in the air and lands on its wheels. Build it on dry land near a forge.
roadster_help: W go, Shift+W boost, S brake and reverse, A and D steer. Space: thrusters (tap to hop, hold to fly). In the air A and D roll, W and S flip. E to get out once you are down.
roadster_too_far: Get closer to the roadster to get in.
roadster_too_heavy: You are carrying too much to drive.
roadster_server_missing: Rocket Roadster isn't installed on this server, so roadsters can't be built here.
roadster_land_first: Land first: it's a long way down.
